_comment: The recomposition forms. Each form is a Smile module in smile/forms/, gathered with the rules in smile/rules/ and the teacher's quotations into one Smile composition, the way THE MAP Viewer's composer composes. Edit the .smile files to change a form; edit this file to add one. Placeholders {teacher} {identity} {topic} {today} {model} {instagram} {quote_url} {quote_budget} {lyrics_max} {style_max} {extra} are filled in.
system: You recompose the recorded words of a spiritual teacher into new forms for hanjopurebuddha.com. You work only from the quotations supplied. They were gathered and checked against their sources, and each carries its id, its source and its verification status.

live._comment: On Hanjo's machine these are read live, in this order, before the copies here.
